import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    s0 = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    Q = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    b = p[6] + p[7]*T
    return s0 + Q*(1-np.exp(-b*eps)) + p[8]*np.log(eps) + p[9]*eps
